Do not rebuild or modify the application binaries. Configure each runtime using the environment variables below.\n\n## 1. API Service (`api_image` on ECS Fargate)\n\n- **Binary**: `/usr/local/bin/clearledger-api`\n- **Listening port**: `8080` (`PORT=8080`)\n- **Required environment variables**:\n  - `PORT`: `\"8080\"`\n  - `AWS_REGION`: region from `config.json` (`us-east-1`)\n  - `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`: region from `config.json` (`us-east-1`)\n  - `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL`: control-plane endpoint reachable from the container (`http://aws:4566`)\n  - `DATABASE_URL`: PostgreSQL connection string `postgres://<db_username>:<db_password>@<rds_host>:<rds_port>/<db_name>`\n  - `SQS_QUEUE_URL`: URL of the main SQS event queue\n  - `PROJECTION_TABLE`: name of the DynamoDB projection table\n  - `VALKEY_URL`: Valkey connection URL `redis://<valkey_host>:<valkey_port>`\n  - `CACHE_TTL_SECONDS`: `\"90\"` (must be explicitly set to `\"90\"`)\n  - `AUTH_ISSUER`: Cognito issuer URL (`http://aws:4566/<user_pool_id>`)\n  - `AUTH_AUDIENCES`: comma-separated Cognito client IDs (`<read_client_id>,<write_client_id>,<admin_client_id>`)\n  - `AUTH_JWKS_URL`: Cognito JWKS URL (`http://aws:4566/<user_pool_id>/.well-known/jwks.json`)\n  - `CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP`: name of the API CloudWatch Log Group\n  - `SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` (optional): instance identifier returned in `X-ClearLedger-Instance` (defaults to `HOSTNAME`)\n\nUpon startup, `clearledger-api` connects to PostgreSQL and serves HTTP traffic on `0.0.0.0:8080`. The application binaries do **not** run database migrations automatically: `deploy.sh` must idempotently apply the `clearledger` PostgreSQL schema (`clearledger.settlements`, `clearledger.events`, `clearledger.outbox`, `clearledger.idempotency_keys`), all required relational `CHECK` / `UNIQUE` / `FOREIGN KEY` constraints, all state-transition, cross-table, and append-only triggers across all four tables, and its six required indexes as defined in `services/rds.md` before `GET /health/ready` reports `200 OK` (`checks.postgres = \"UP\"`). During `POST /v1/settlements` and `POST /v1/settlements/{id}/entries`, `clearledger-api` maps PostgreSQL constraint and trigger exceptions (`SQLSTATE 23514`, `23503`, `23502`, `23505`, and `P0001`) to HTTP `400 Bad Request` (`invalid_settlement`).\n\n## 2. Projector Worker (`projector_image` on AWS Lambda)\n\n- **Bootstrap**: `/var/runtime/bootstrap`\n- **Trigger**: SQS event source mapping from the main SQS queue (`batch_size = 5`, `maximum_batching_window_in_seconds = 0`, `function_response_types = [\"ReportBatchItemFailures\"]`)\n- **Required environment variables**:\n  - `AWS_REGION`: region from `config.json`\n  - `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`: region from `config.json`\n  - `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL`: `\"http://aws:4566\"`\n  - `PROJECTION_TABLE`: name of the DynamoDB projection table\n  - `VALKEY_URL`: `redis://<valkey_host>:<valkey_port>`\n  - `CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP`: name of the projector CloudWatch Log Group\n\nFor each valid event envelope in the SQS batch:\n- Inserts the event item (`PK = \"SETTLEMENT#<settlement_id>\"`, `SK = \"EVENT#<8-digit-zero-padded-version>\"`) in DynamoDB using a conditional `attribute_not_exists(PK) AND attribute_not_exists(SK)` write (storing `entry_id` and `memo` on the `EVENT#*` item only when present/non-null on that event's `data`).\n- Updates the aggregate state item (`PK = \"SETTLEMENT#<settlement_id>\"`, `SK = \"STATE\"`, `GSI1PK = \"ACCOUNT#<account_id>\"`, `GSI1SK = \"SETTLEMENT#<settlement_id>\"`) using a conditional write only when `aggregateVersion` is strictly greater than the stored `version`. When `envelope.data.memo` is non-null, `STATE.last_memo` is updated to that value; when `envelope.data.memo` is `null` (`None`), `STATE.last_memo` retains the previous non-null `last_memo` (so `STATE.last_memo` always reflects the latest non-null memo across versions `1..version`). Duplicate or older versions are ignored idempotently; if an older version (such as `v1`) arrives after a newer version, any missing static metadata (`reference`, `debit_party`, `credit_party`) is backfilled without regressing `version`, `status`, or `clearing_stage`.\n- Deletes the Valkey key `clearledger:settlement:<settlement_id>` and emits a structured JSON log entry (`{\"service\": \"clearledger-projector\", \"event\": \"projected\", \"settlementId\": \"<id>\", \"eventId\": \"<event_id>\", \"version\": <v>, \"correlationId\": \"<cid>\", \"updated\": <bool>}`) to `logs.projector_log_group`.\n- If any record fails validation or deserialization, its `messageId` is returned in `batchItemFailures` so SQS retries only the failed message and routes poison messages to the DLQ after `maxReceiveCount = 4` receives.\n\n## 3. Outbox Relay Worker (`relay_image` on AWS Lambda)\n\n- **Bootstrap**: `/var/runtime/bootstrap`\n- **Trigger**: EventBridge Scheduler every 1 minute (`rate(1 minute)`)\n- **Required environment variables**:\n  - `AWS_REGION`: region from `config.json`\n  - `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`: region from `config.json`\n  - `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL`: `\"http://aws:4566\"`\n  - `DATABASE_URL`: `postgres://<db_username>:<db_password>@<rds_host>:<rds_port>/<db_name>`\n  - `SQS_QUEUE_URL`: URL of the main SQS event queue\n  - `OUTBOX_BATCH_SIZE`: `\"50\"` (must be explicitly set to `\"50\"`)\n  - `CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP`: name of the relay CloudWatch Log Group\n\nQueries up to `OUTBOX_BATCH_SIZE` rows from `clearledger.outbox` where `published_at IS NULL` ordered by `seq ASC`, sends each event envelope to `SQS_QUEUE_URL`, updates `published_at = NOW(), attempts = attempts + 1, last_error = NULL`, and emits `{\"service\": \"clearledger-outbox-relay\", \"event\": \"relay_tick\", \"published\": <count>, \"failed\": <count>}` to `logs.relay_log_group`.\n\n## 4. Audit Archiver Worker (`archiver_image` on AWS Lambda)\n\n- **Bootstrap**: `/var/runtime/bootstrap`\n- **Trigger**: EventBridge Scheduler every 5 minutes (`rate(5 minutes)`)\n- **Required environment variables**:\n  - `AWS_REGION`: region from `config.json`\n  - `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`: region from `config.json`\n  - `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL`: `\"http://aws:4566\"`\n  - `DATABASE_URL`: `postgres://<db_username>:<db_password>@<rds_host>:<rds_port>/<db_name>`\n  - `AUDIT_BUCKET`: name of the S3 audit archive bucket\n  - `AUDIT_PREFIX`: `\"ledger-audit/\"` (must be explicitly set to `\"ledger-audit/\"`)\n  - `AUDIT_BATCH_SIZE` (optional): defaults to `100`\n  - `CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP`: name of the archiver CloudWatch Log Group\n\nSelects published outbox rows (`published_at IS NOT NULL AND archived_at IS NULL`) ordered by `seq ASC`, deserializes each row's `payload` into `DomainEventEnvelope` and serializes it as compact NDJSON in canonical struct field order (`schemaVersion`, `eventId`, `eventType`, `settlementId`, `aggregateVersion`, `occurredAt`, `correlationId`, `idempotencyKey`, `data` with `kind` first) to `s3://<AUDIT_BUCKET>/ledger-audit/batch-<first_seq:08d>-<last_seq:08d>-<16_char_sha256_hex>.ndjson`, sets `archived_at = NOW()`, and emits `{\"service\": \"clearledger-audit-archiver\", \"event\": \"archive_batch\", \"archived\": <count>, \"bucket\": \"<bucket>\", \"key\": \"<key>\"}` to `logs.archiver_log_group`.\n\n## 5. OAuth2 Scopes and Authorization\n\nAll protected endpoints validate Bearer JWTs issued by the Cognito User Pool against `AUTH_ISSUER`, `AUTH_JWKS_URL`, and `AUTH_AUDIENCES`. Scopes are strictly non-hierarchical:\n\n- `clearledger/read`: permitted only on `GET /v1/settlements/{id}` and `GET /v1/settlements/{id}/ledger`.\n- `clearledger/write`: permitted only on `POST /v1/settlements` and `POST /v1/settlements/{id}/entries`.\n- `clearledger/admin`: permitted only on `POST /v1/admin/projections/{id}/rebuild`.\n\nMissing or invalid tokens return `401 Unauthorized`; valid tokens lacking the exact endpoint scope return `403 Forbidden`.\n\n## 6. Recovery Drills, Bidirectional Data-Plane Reconciliation, and Lifecycle\n\n- **Backlog & DLQ**: When the projector event source mapping is disabled, API writes commit to PostgreSQL and enqueue on SQS while `GET /v1/settlements/{id}` returns `404` until re-enabled. Duplicate, out-of-order, and concurrent event deliveries are handled without version regression; invalid envelopes are retried and routed to the DLQ after `maxReceiveCount = 4`.\n- **Bidirectional Multi-Store & Control-Plane Convergence in `deploy.sh`**:\n  - PostgreSQL (`clearledger.settlements`, `clearledger.events`, `clearledger.outbox`) is the authoritative system of record; DynamoDB, Valkey, and S3 are derived read/archive stores.\n  - Because `clearledger-projector` writes `EVENT#*` items conditionally with `attribute_not_exists(PK) AND attribute_not_exists(SK)` and updates `STATE` conditionally only when `aggregateVersion > current_version`, and because `clearledger-audit-archiver` only archives rows where `published_at IS NOT NULL AND archived_at IS NULL`, `deploy.sh` must converge both the control plane (all service configurations, tags, security groups, IAM role policies, resource-based policies on KMS/S3/SQS, and PostgreSQL schema/constraints/triggers/indexes) and all derived data stores (SQS outbox relay, DynamoDB projections, Valkey cache entries, and the versioned S3 `ledger-audit/` archive) against PostgreSQL as specified in `/workspace/contracts/services/*.md` before exiting `0`.\n- **Prefix-Scoped Teardown in `destroy.sh`**:\n  - `destroy.sh` must cleanly tear down all Terraform-managed resources as well as any out-of-band resources scoped to `<resource_prefix>` (by name prefix or `ClearLedgerDeployment = <resource_prefix>` tag) across all AWS services while keeping all `cl-base-*` baseline resources intact.\n- **Structured Logs**: All four workloads emit JSON log lines containing `correlationId` (propagated from `X-Correlation-Id`) to their configured CloudWatch Log Groups without leaking `db_password` or Cognito `client_secret` values.\n\n# VPC and Security Groups (`services/vpc.md`)\n\n- Provision one VPC (`aws_vpc`) with DNS support (`enable_dns_support = true`) and DNS hostnames (`enable_dns_hostnames = true`) enabled.\n- Create at least two public subnets (`aws_subnet`, `map_public_ip_on_launch = true`) across `us-east-1a` and `us-east-1b`.\n- Create at least two private subnets (`aws_subnet`, `map_public_ip_on_launch = false`) across `us-east-1a` and `us-east-1b`.\n- Attach an Internet Gateway (`aws_internet_gateway`) to the VPC and associate (`aws_route_table_association`) a public route table (`0.0.0.0/0` -> Internet Gateway) with both public subnets.\n- Associate (`aws_route_table_association`) a private route table (with no route to an Internet Gateway) with both private subnets.\n- Create four distinct dedicated security groups (`aws_security_group`, four distinct security group IDs) enforcing least-privilege ingress and egress:\n  - `alb`:\n    - **Ingress**: TCP port `80` (`from_port = 80`, `to_port = 80`, `protocol = \"tcp\"`) from `0.0.0.0/0`.\n    - **Egress**: TCP port `8080` (`from_port = 8080`, `to_port = 8080`, `protocol = \"tcp\"`) targeting the `ecs` security group or VPC CIDR (must not have explicit TCP/UDP egress rules allowing `0.0.0.0/0` or `::/0`).\n  - `ecs`:\n    - **Ingress**: restricted strictly to TCP port `8080` (`from_port = 8080`, `to_port = 8080`, `protocol = \"tcp\"`) from the `alb` security group ID (never `0.0.0.0/0`, `::/0`, or any CIDR block).\n    - **Egress**: outbound traffic to the AWS control plane and data stores.\n  - `rds`:\n    - **Ingress**: restricted strictly to TCP port `5432` (`from_port = 5432`, `to_port = 5432`, `protocol = \"tcp\"`) from the `ecs` security group or VPC CIDR (never `0.0.0.0/0` or `::/0`).\n    - Table `clearledger.settlements`\n\n- **Columns**:\n  - `settlement_id UUID NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY`\n  - `account_id TEXT NOT NULL`\n  - `reference TEXT NOT NULL`\n  - `debit_party TEXT NOT NULL`\n  - `credit_party TEXT NOT NULL`\n  - `current_status TEXT NOT NULL`\n  - `current_stage TEXT NOT NULL`\n  - `last_entry_id UUID NULL`\n  - `last_memo TEXT NOT NULL`\n  - `version INTEGER NOT NULL`\n  - `entry_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`\n  - `created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()`\n  - `updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()`\n- **Required invariants (enforced via `CHECK` constraints and `BEFORE UPDATE`/`BEFORE DELETE` triggers)**:\n  - Canonical trimmed strings and length bounds: `account_id`, `reference`, `debit_party`, `credit_party`, `current_stage`, and `last_memo` must be non-null and stored in canonical trimmed form (`col = btrim(col)`, no leading or trailing whitespace) and match the length bounds and allowed status values of `CreateSettlementRequest` and `AppendEntryRequest` in `openapi.yaml` (`1..256` characters for `last_memo`), with `debit_party <> credit_party` and `version >= 1`.\n  - At initiation (`version = 1`), `entry_count = 0`, `current_status = 'INITIATED'`, `current_stage = 'INITIATED@' || debit_party`, `last_entry_id IS NULL`, `last_memo = 'Settlement initiated'`, and `updated_at = created_at`. For `version > 1`, `entry_count = version - 1`, `current_status <> 'INITIATED'`, `last_entry_id IS NOT NULL`, `last_memo IS NOT NULL`, and `updated_at > created_at`.\n  - On `UPDATE`:\n    - Because `POST /v1/settlements/{id}/entries` allows `memo` to be omitted (`NULL` in the `UPDATE clearledger.settlements` statement executed by `clearledger-api`), when `NEW.last_memo IS NULL` on `UPDATE`, the `BEFORE UPDATE` trigger must retain the previous non-null memo (`NEW.last_memo := COALESCE(NEW.last_memo, OLD.last_memo)`) so `clearledger.settlements.last_memo` is never `NULL` and always matches `clearledger-projector`'s `STATE.last_memo` projection.\n    - Header columns (`settlement_id`, `account_id`, `reference`, `debit_party`, `credit_party`, `created_at`) are immutable; each update must step `version` and `entry_count` by `+1` with a new `last_entry_id` (`NEW.last_entry_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_entry_id`) and a strictly increasing `updated_at` timestamp (`NEW.updated_at > OLD.updated_at`); and `current_status` must follow the clearing lifecycle progression:\n    - The non-`DISPUTED` clearing status rank order is `INITIATED` (`0`) < `VALIDATED` (`1`) < `RESERVED` (`2`) < `CLEARED` (`3`) < `SETTLED` (`4`) < `RECONCILED` (`5`).\n    - `RECONCILED` is strictly terminal: once `OLD.current_status = 'RECONCILED'`, any `UPDATE` on the settlement row must be rejected (even if `NEW.current_status = 'RECONCILED'`).\n    - From any non-`RECONCILED`, non-`DISPUTED` status (`INITIATED`, `VALIDATED`, `RESERVED`, `CLEARED`, `SETTLED`), `NEW.current_status` may transition to `'DISPUTED'` or to any status whose rank is monotonic non-decreasing (`rank(NEW.current_status) >= rank(OLD.current_status)` — permitting same-status updates such as `CLEARED` -> `CLEARED` and single- or multi-stage forward advances such as `INITIATED` -> `VALIDATED` or `INITIATED` -> `CLEARED`, while rejecting any backward rank regression where `rank(NEW.current_status) < rank(OLD.current_status)` such as `CLEARED` -> `RESERVED`).\n    - From `OLD.current_status = 'DISPUTED'`, `NEW.current_status` may only remain `'DISPUTED'` or resolve to terminal `'RECONCILED'`.\n  - `clearledger.settlements` is an append-only ledger aggregate root (`DELETE` must be rejected).\n\n### 2. Table `clearledger.events`\n\n- **Columns**:\n  - `seq BIGSERIAL NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY`\n  - `event_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE`\n  - `settlement_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES clearledger.settlements(settlement_id) ON DELETE CASCADE`\n  - `aggregate_version INTEGER NOT NULL`\n  - `event_type TEXT NOT NULL`\n  - `correlation_id TEXT NOT NULL`\n  - `idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL`\n  - `occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL`\n  - `payload JSONB NOT NULL`\n  - `created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()`\n- **Required invariants (enforced via `UNIQUE`/`CHECK` constraints and `BEFORE INSERT`/`UPDATE`/`DELETE` triggers)**:\n  - Composite `UNIQUE (settlement_id, aggregate_version)` and `UNIQUE (settlement_id, idempotency_key)`, with canonical trimmed storage (`col = btrim(col)`) and length bounds on `correlation_id` and `idempotency_key` matching `openapi.yaml`.\n  - `payload` must conform strictly to `ClearLedgerDomainEventEnvelope` in `schemas/events.schema.json` (including `additionalProperties: false` on both the envelope and `payload.data`, required non-null canonically trimmed `accountId`, `reference`, `debitParty`, `creditParty`, `status`, and `clearingStage` in `payload.data` with length bounds matching `openapi.yaml` and `1..256` canonically trimmed characters when `data.memo` is non-null, column-to-envelope equality across `event_id`, `settlement_id`, `aggregate_version`, `event_type`, `correlation_id`, `idempotency_key`, and `occurred_at` compared as `TIMESTAMPTZ`, and version/kind/status/entryId coupling for `SettlementInitiated` at `v = 1` with `data.clearingStage = 'INITIATED@' || (data.debitParty)` and `data.memo = 'Settlement initiated'` vs `LedgerEntryRecorded` at `v >= 2`).\n  - On `INSERT`: per-settlement `aggregate_version` must be contiguous starting at `1`; Projector Worker (`projector_image` on AWS Lambda)\n\n- **Bootstrap**: `/var/runtime/bootstrap`\n- **Trigger**: SQS event source mapping from the main SQS queue (`batch_size = 5`, `maximum_batching_window_in_seconds = 0`, `function_response_types = [\"ReportBatchItemFailures\"]`)\n- **Required environment variables**:\n  - `AWS_REGION`: region from `config.json`\n  - `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`: region from `config.json`\n  - `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL`: `\"http://aws:4566\"`\n  - `PROJECTION_TABLE`: name of the DynamoDB projection table\n  - `VALKEY_URL`: `redis://<valkey_host>:<valkey_port>`\n  - `CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP`: name of the projector CloudWatch Log Group\n\nFor each valid event envelope in the SQS batch:\n- Inserts the event item (`PK = \"SETTLEMENT#<settlement_id>\"`, `SK = \"EVENT#<8-digit-zero-padded-version>\"`) in DynamoDB using a conditional `attribute_not_exists(PK) AND attribute_not_exists(SK)` write (storing `entry_id` and `memo` on the `EVENT#*` item only when present/non-null on that event's `data`).\n- Updates the aggregate state item (`PK = \"SETTLEMENT#<settlement_id>\"`, `SK = \"STATE\"`, `GSI1PK = \"ACCOUNT#<account_id>\"`, `GSI1SK = \"SETTLEMENT#<settlement_id>\"`) using a conditional write only when `aggregateVersion` is strictly greater than the stored `version`. When `envelope.data.memo` is non-null, `STATE.last_memo` is updated to that value; when `envelope.data.memo` is `null` (`None`), `STATE.last_memo` retains the previous non-null `last_memo` (so `STATE.last_memo` always reflects the latest non-null memo across versions `1..version`). Duplicate or older versions are ignored idempotently; if an older version (such as `v1`) arrives after a newer version, any missing static metadata (`reference`, `debit_party`, `credit_party`) is backfilled without regressing `version`, `status`, or `clearing_stage`.\n- Deletes the Valkey key `clearledger:settlement:<settlement_id>` and emits a structured JSON log entry (`{\"service\": \"clearledger-projector\", \"event\": \"projected\", \"settlementId\": \"<id>\", \"eventId\": \"<event_id>\", \"version\": <v>, \"correlationId\": \"<cid>\", \"updated\": <bool>}`) to `logs.projector_log_group`.\n- If any record fails validation or deserialization, its `messageId` is returned in `batchItemFailures` so SQS retries only the failed message and routes poison messages to the DLQ after `maxReceiveCount = 4` receives.\n\n## 3. `deletion_window_in_days = 10` (must be `10..30` days)\n- Tags `ClearLedgerDeployment = <resource_prefix>` and `ClearLedgerKeyUsage = <database|messaging|projection|audit>` (matching its respective role: `database`, `messaging`, `projection`, or `audit`)\n- **Resource-based KMS key policy (`aws_kms_key.policy` or `aws_kms_key_policy`)**:\n  - Grants key administration to the AWS account root principal (`arn:aws:iam::000000000000:root`).\n  - Explicitly allows (`Effect = \"Allow\"`) cryptographic usage (`kms:Decrypt`, `kms:GenerateDataKey`, `kms:DescribeKey`) to the exact ClearLedger workload IAM role ARNs authorized for that key:\n    - `database`: `iam.relay_role_arn` and `iam.archiver_role_arn`\n    - `messaging`: `iam.ecs_task_role_arn`, `iam.projector_role_arn`, and `iam.relay_role_arn`\n    - `projection`: `iam.ecs_task_role_arn` and `iam.projector_role_arn`\n    - `audit`: `iam.archiver_role_arn`\n  - Explicitly denies (`Effect = \"Deny\"`) `kms:DisableKey` and `kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion` when the principal is any of the six ClearLedger workload IAM role ARNs (`ecs_execution`, `ecs_task`, `projector`, `relay`, `archiver`, `scheduler`), and explicitly denies (`Effect = \"Deny\"`) `kms:Decrypt` and `kms:GenerateDataKey` when the principal is any of the ClearLedger workload IAM role ARNs not authorized for that key.\n- Re-running `deploy.sh` must ensure all four KMS keys remain enabled (`KeyState = \"Enabled\"`), have `enable_key_rotation = true`, retain their canonical `ClearLedgerDeployment` and `ClearLedgerKeyUsage` tags, and enforce their canonical 'occurredAt')::timestamptz;\n  IF NOT clearledger.is_canonical_text(clearledger.jtext(p, 'correlationId'), 4, 128) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF NOT jsonb_object_keys(d) k WHERE k <> ALL (dkeys)) THEN\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  IF clearledger.jtext(d, 'kind') IS NULL\n     OR clearledger.jtext(d, 'kind') NOT IN ('settlementInitiated','ledgerEntryRecorded') THEN\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.is_canonical_text(clearledger.jtext(d, 'accountId'), 3, 64)    THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.is_canonical_text(clearledger.jtext(d, 'reference'), 3, 64)    THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.is_canonical_text(clearledger.jtext(d, 'debitParty'), 2, 64)   THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.is_canonical_text(clearledger.jtext(d, 'creditParty'), 2, 64)  THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.is_canonical_text(clearledger.jtext(d, 'clearingStage'), 2, 74) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.is_status(clearledger.jtext(d, 'status')) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF clearledger.jtext(d, 'debitParty') = clearledger.jtext(d, 'creditParty') THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n\n  -- entryId: absent, null, or a UUID string\n  IF d ? 'entryId' AND jsonb_typeof(d -> 'entryId') <> 'null'\n     AND NOT clearledger.is_uuid_text(clearledger.jtext(d, 'entryId')) THEN\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  -- memo: absent, null, or a canonical 1..256 character string\n  IF d ? 'memo' AND jsonb_typeof(d -> 'memo') <> 'null'\n     AND NOT clearledger.is_canonical_text(clearledger.jtext(d, 'memo'), 1, 256) THEN\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN true;\nEXCEPTION WHEN others THEN\n  RETURN false;\nEND $f$;\n\n-- Column / envelope equality for an events row.\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.envelope_matches_event(\n  p jsonb, c_event_id uuid, c_settlement_id uuid, c_version integer, c_event_type text,\n  c_correlation_id text, c_idempotency_key text, c_occurred_at timestamptz)\nRETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $f$\nBEGIN\n  RETURN clearledger.envelope_valid(p)\n     AND (p ->> 'eventId')::uuid          = c_event_id\n     AND (p ->> 'aggregateId')::uuid      = c_settlement_id\n     AND (p ->> 'aggregateVersion')::int  = c_version\n     AND (p ->> 'eventType')              = c_event_type\n     AND (p ->> 'correlationId')          = c_correlation_id\n     AND (p ->> 'idempotencyKey')         = c_idempotency_key\n     AND (p ->> 'occurredAt')::timestamptz = c_occurred_at;\nEXCEPTION WHEN others THEN\n  RETURN false;\nEND $f$;\n\n-- Column / envelope equality for an outbox row.\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.envelope_matches_outbox(\n  p jsonb, c_event_id uuid, c_settlement_id uuid, c_version integer, c_correlation_id text)\nRETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $f$\nBEGIN\n  RETURN clearledger.envelope_valid(p)\n     AND (p ->> 'eventId')::uuid          = c_event_id\n     AND (p ->> 'aggregateId')::uuid      = c_settlement_id\n     AND (p ->> 'aggregateVersion')::int  = c_version\n     AND (p ->> 'correlationId')          = c_correlation_id;\nEXCEPTION WHEN others THEN\n  RETURN false;\nEND $f$;\n\n-- Version / kind / status / entryId coupling of an event envelope.\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.event_coupling_ok(p jsonb, c_version integer, c_event_type text)\nRETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $f$\nDECLARE\n  d jsonb := p -> 'data';\nBEGIN\n  IF c_version = 1 THEN\n    RETURN c_event_type = 'SettlementInitiated'\n       AND clearledger.jtext(d, 'kind')   = 'settlementInitiated'\n       AND clearledger.jtext(d, 'status') = 'INITIATED'\n       AND clearledger.jtext(d, 'entryId') IS NULL\n       AND clearledger.jtext(d, 'clearingStage') = 'INITIATED@' || clearledger.jtext(d, 'debitParty')\n       AND clearledger.jtext(d, 'memo')   = 'Settlement initiated';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN c_version > 1\n     AND c_event_type = 'LedgerEntryRecorded'\n     AND clearledger.jtext(d, 'kind')   = 'ledgerEntryRecorded'\n     AND clearledger.jtext(d, 'status') <> 'INITIATED'\n     AND clearledger.is_uuid_text(clearledger.jtext(d, 'entryId'))\n     AND char_length(clearledger.jtext(d, 'clearingStage')) <= 64;\nEXCEPTION WHEN others THEN\n  RETURN false;\nEND $f$;\n\n-- Closed-schema WriteAcceptedResponse stored with an idempotency key.\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.idempotency_body_ok(b jsonb, c_scope text, c_status integer)\nRETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $f$\nDECLARE\n  keys text[] := ARRAY['settlementId','eventId','version','accepted','idempotentReplay'];\n  v    integer;\nBEGIN\n  IF b IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(b) <> 'object' THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(b)) <> 5\n     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(b) k WHERE k <> ALL (keys)) THEN\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.is_uuid_text(clearledger.jtext(b, 'settlementId'))\n     OR NOT clearledger.is_uuid_text(clearledger.jtext(b, 'eventId')) THEN\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  IF jsonb_typeof(b -> 'version') <> 'number' OR (b ->> 'version') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,8}$' THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF b -> 'accepted' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb OR b -> 'idempotentReplay' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb THEN\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  v := (b ->> 'version')::integer;\n  IF c_scope ~ '^create:' THEN\n    IF c_status <> 201 OR v <> 1 THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  ELSIF c_scope ~ '^entry:' THEN\n    IF c_status <> 202 OR v < 2 THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  ELSE\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN lower(substr(c_scope, position(':' in c_scope) + 1)) = lower(b ->> 'settlementId');\nEXCEPTION WHEN others THEN\n  RETURN false;\nEND $f$;\n\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n-- Trigger functions.\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.reject_mutation()\nRETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$\nBEGIN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION '% on %.% is forbidden: table is append-only', TG_OP, TG_TABLE_SCHEMA, TG_TABLE_NAME\n    USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\nEND $f$;\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.settlements_before_update()\nRETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$\nBEGIN\n  -- An omitted memo keeps the previous one so last_memo is never NULL.\n  NEW.last_memo := COALESCE(NEW.last_memo, OLD.last_memo);\n\n  IF OLD.current_status = 'RECONCILED' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement % is RECONCILED and can no longer be updated', OLD.settlement_id\n      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.settlement_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.settlement_id\n     OR NEW.account_id   IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.account_id\n     OR NEW.reference    IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reference\n     OR NEW.debit_party  IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.debit_party\n     OR NEW.credit_party IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_party\n     OR NEW.created_at   IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement % header columns are immutable', OLD.settlement_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.version + 1 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement % version must advance from % by exactly 1', OLD.settlement_id, OLD.version\n      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.entry_count IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.entry_count + 1 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement % entry_count must advance by exactly 1', OLD.settlement_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.last_entry_id IS NULL OR NEW.last_entry_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_entry_id THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement % update requires a new last_entry_id', OLD.settlement_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF (NEW.updated_at > OLD.updated_at) IS NOT TRUE THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement % updated_at must strictly increase', OLD.settlement_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.status_transition_ok(OLD.current_status, NEW.current_status) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement % status transition % -> % is not allowed',\n      OLD.settlement_id, OLD.current_status, NEW.current_status USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND $f$;\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.events_before_insert()\nRETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$\nDECLARE\n  s          clearledger.settlements%ROWTYPE;\n  d          jsonb := NEW.payload -> 'data';\n  last_ver   integer;\n  prev_at    timestamptz;\n  prev_state text;\n  want_memo  text;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO s FROM clearledger.settlements WHERE settlement_id = NEW.settlement_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'event % references unknown settlement %', NEW.event_id, NEW.settlement_id\n      USING ERRCODE = 'foreign_key_violation';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT max(aggregate_version) INTO last_ver FROM clearledger.events WHERE settlement_id = NEW.settlement_id;\n  IF NEW.aggregate_version IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(last_ver, 0) + 1 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement % aggregate_version must be contiguous: expected %, got %',\n      NEW.settlement_id, COALESCE(last_ver, 0) + 1, NEW.aggregate_version USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NEW.event_type = 'LedgerEntryRecorded' AND EXISTS (\n       SELECT 1 FROM clearledger.events e\n        WHERE e.settlement_id = NEW.settlement_id\n          AND e.event_type = 'LedgerEntryRecorded'\n          AND e.payload -> 'data' ->> 'entryId' = d ->> 'entryId') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'entryId % already recorded for settlement %', d ->> 'entryId', NEW.settlement_id\n      USING ERRCODE = 'unique_violation';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- The event must describe the settlement row it was committed with.\n  IF s.account_id   IS DISTINCT FROM d ->> 'accountId'\n     OR s.reference    IS DISTINCT FROM d ->> 'reference'\n     OR s.debit_party  IS DISTINCT FROM d ->> 'debitParty'\n     OR s.credit_party IS DISTINCT FROM d ->> 'creditParty'\n     OR s.current_status IS DISTINCT FROM d ->> 'status'\n     OR s.current_stage  IS DISTINCT FROM d ->> 'clearingStage'\n     OR s.last_entry_id  IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(d ->> 'entryId', '')::uuid\n     OR s.version        IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.aggregate_version\n     OR s.updated_at     IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.occurred_at\n     OR (NEW.aggregate_version = 1 AND s.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.occurred_at) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'event % does not match settlement % row at version %',\n      NEW.event_id, NEW.settlement_id, s.version USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n\n  want_memo := d ->> 'memo';\n  IF want_memo IS NULL THEN\n    SELECT e.payload -> 'data' ->> 'memo' INTO want_memo\n      FROM clearledger.events e\n     WHERE e.settlement_id = NEW.settlement_id\n       AND e.aggregate_version < NEW.aggregate_version\n       AND e.payload -> 'data' ->> 'memo' IS NOT NULL\n     ORDER BY e.aggregate_version DESC\n     LIMIT 1;\n  END IF;\n  IF s.last_memo IS DISTINCT FROM want_memo THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'event % memo does not match settlement % last_memo', NEW.event_id, NEW.settlement_id\n      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NEW.aggregate_version >= 2 THEN\n    SELECT e.occurred_at, e.payload -> 'data' ->> 'status' INTO prev_at, prev_state\n      FROM clearledger.events e\n     WHERE e.settlement_id = NEW.settlement_id AND e.aggregate_version = NEW.aggregate_version - 1;\n    IF prev_at IS NULL OR (NEW.occurred_at > prev_at) IS NOT TRUE THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'event % occurred_at must be strictly after the previous event', NEW.event_id\n        USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n    END IF;\n    IF NOT clearledger.status_transition_ok(prev_state, d ->> 'status') THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'event % status transition % -> % is not allowed', NEW.event_id, prev_state, d ->> 'status'\n        USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND $f$;\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.outbox_before_insert()\nRETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$\nDECLARE\n  ev       clearledger.events%ROWTYPE;\n  last_ver integer;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO ev FROM clearledger.events WHERE event_id = NEW.event_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox row references unknown event %', NEW.event_id USING ERRCODE = 'foreign_key_violation';\n  END IF;\n  IF ev.settlement_id <> NEW.settlement_id\n     OR ev.aggregate_version <> NEW.aggregate_version\n     OR ev.correlation_id <> NEW.correlation_id\n     OR ev.payload IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.payload THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox row for event % must mirror the events row', NEW.event_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT max(aggregate_version) INTO last_ver FROM clearledger.outbox WHERE settlement_id = NEW.settlement_id;\n  IF NEW.aggregate_version IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(last_ver, 0) + 1 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox aggregate_version for settlement % must be contiguous: expected %, got %',\n      NEW.settlement_id, COALESCE(last_ver, 0) + 1, NEW.aggregate_version USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND $f$;\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.outbox_before_update()\nRETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.seq IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.seq\n     OR NEW.event_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.event_id\n     OR NEW.settlement_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.settlement_id\n     OR NEW.aggregate_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.aggregate_version\n     OR NEW.correlation_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.correlation_id\n     OR NEW.payload IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.payload\n     OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox envelope columns of event % are immutable', OLD.event_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.attempts < OLD.attempts THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox attempts of event % cannot decrease', OLD.event_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF OLD.published_at IS NULL THEN\n    IF NEW.published_at IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.attempts <= OLD.attempts OR NEW.archived_at IS NOT NULL) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'publishing outbox event % requires attempts to increase and archived_at to stay NULL',\n        OLD.event_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n    END IF;\n  ELSE\n    IF NEW.published_at IS NOT NULL THEN\n      IF NEW.published_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.published_at\n         OR NEW.attempts IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.attempts\n         OR NEW.last_error IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_error THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION 'published outbox event % delivery columns are immutable', OLD.event_id\n          USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n      END IF;\n      IF OLD.archived_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.archived_at IS NOT NULL\n         AND NEW.archived_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.archived_at THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION 'archived_at of outbox event % cannot change without being reset first', OLD.event_id\n          USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n      END IF;\n    ELSE\n      -- operational replay: published_at and archived_at are reset together\n      IF NEW.archived_at IS NOT NULL\n         OR NEW.attempts IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.attempts\n         OR NEW.last_error IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_error THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION 'replay reset of outbox event % must clear both published_at and archived_at', OLD.event_id\n          USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND $f$;\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.idempotency_before_insert()\nRETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$\nDECLARE\n  b          jsonb := NEW.response_body;\n  ev_id      uuid;\n  s_id       uuid;\n  ver        integer;\nBEGIN\n  BEGIN\n    ev_id := (b ->> 'eventId')::uuid;\n    s_id  := (b ->> 'settlementId')::uuid;\n    ver   := (b ->> 'version')::integer;\n  EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'idempotency response_body is not a WriteAcceptedResponse' USING WHERE (k.response_body ->> 'eventId')::uuid = ev_id\n                 OR ((k.response_body ->> 'settlementId')::uuid = s_id\n                     AND (k.response_body ->> 'version')::integer = ver)) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'event % is already bound to an idempotency key', ev_id USING ERRCODE = 'unique_violation';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND $f$;\n\n-- clearledger.is_canonical_text(clearledger.jtext(p, 'idempotencyKey'), 8, 128) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n\n  d := p -> 'data';\n  IF jsonb_typeof(d) <> 'object'\n     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(d) k WHERE k <> ALL (dkeys)) THEN\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  IF clearledger.jtext(d, 'kind') IS NULL\n     OR clearledger.jtext(d, 'kind') NOT IN ('settlementInitiated','ledgerEntryRecorded') THEN\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.is_canonical_text(clearledger.jtext(d, 'accountId'), 3, 64)    THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.is_canonical_text(clearledger.jtext(d, 'reference'), 3, 64)    THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.is_canonical_text(clearledger.jtext(d, 'debitParty'), 2, 64)   THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.is_canonical_text(clearledger.jtext(d, 'creditParty'), 2, 64)  THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.is_canonical_text(clearledger.jtext(d, 'clearingStage'), 2, 74) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.is_status(clearledger.jtext(d, 'status')) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF clearledger.jtext(d, 'debitParty') = clearledger.jtext(d, 'creditParty') THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n\n  -- entryId: absent, null, or a UUID string\n  IF d ? 'entryId' AND jsonb_typeof(d -> 'entryId') <> 'null'\n     AND NOT clearledger.is_uuid_text(clearledger.jtext(d, 'entryId')) THEN\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  -- memo: absent, null, or a canonical 1..256 character string\n  IF d ? 'memo' AND jsonb_typeof(d -> 'memo') <> 'null'\n     AND NOT clearledger.is_canonical_text(clearledger.jtext(d, 'memo'), 1, 256) THEN\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN true;\nEXCEPTION WHEN others THEN\n  RETURN false;\nEND $f$;\n\n-- Column / envelope equality for an events row.\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.envelope_matches_event(\n  p jsonb, c_event_id uuid, c_settlement_id uuid, c_version integer, c_event_type text,\n  c_correlation_id text, c_idempotency_key text, c_occurred_at timestamptz)\nRETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $f$\nBEGIN\n  RETURN clearledger.envelope_valid(p)\n     AND (p ->> 'eventId')::uuid          = c_event_id\n     AND (p ->> 'aggregateId')::uuid      = c_settlement_id\n     AND (p ->> 'aggregateVersion')::int  = c_version\n     AND (p ->> 'eventType')              = c_event_type\n     AND (p ->> 'correlationId')          = c_correlation_id\n     AND (p ->> 'idempotencyKey')         = c_idempotency_key\n     AND (p ->> 'occurredAt')::timestamptz = c_occurred_at;\nEXCEPTION WHEN others THEN\n  RETURN false;\nEND $f$;\n\n-- Column / envelope equality for an outbox row.\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.envelope_matches_outbox(\n  p jsonb, c_event_id uuid, c_settlement_id uuid, c_version integer, c_correlation_id text)\nRETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $f$\nBEGIN\n  RETURN clearledger.envelope_valid(p)\n     AND (p ->> 'eventId')::uuid          = c_event_id\n     AND (p ->> 'aggregateId')::uuid      = c_settlement_id\n     AND (p ->> 'aggregateVersion')::int  = c_version\n     AND (p ->> 'correlationId')          = c_correlation_id;\nEXCEPTION WHEN others THEN\n  RETURN false;\nEND $f$;\n\n-- Version / kind / status / entryId coupling of an event envelope.\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.event_coupling_ok(p jsonb, c_version integer, c_event_type text)\nRETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $f$\nDECLARE\n  d jsonb := p -> 'data';\nBEGIN\n  IF c_version = 1 THEN\n    RETURN c_event_type = 'SettlementInitiated'\n       AND clearledger.jtext(d, 'kind')   = 'settlementInitiated'\n       AND clearledger.jtext(d, 'status') = 'INITIATED'\n       AND clearledger.jtext(d, 'entryId') IS NULL\n       AND clearledger.jtext(d, 'clearingStage') = 'INITIATED@' || clearledger.jtext(d, 'debitParty')\n       AND clearledger.jtext(d, 'memo')   = 'Settlement initiated';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN c_version > 1\n     AND c_event_type = 'LedgerEntryRecorded'\n     AND clearledger.jtext(d, 'kind')   = 'ledgerEntryRecorded'\n     AND clearledger.jtext(d, 'status') <> 'INITIATED'\n     AND clearledger.is_uuid_text(clearledger.jtext(d, 'entryId'))\n     AND char_length(clearledger.jtext(d, 'clearingStage')) <= 64;\nEXCEPTION WHEN others THEN\n  RETURN false;\nEND $f$;\n\n-- Closed-schema WriteAcceptedResponse stored with an idempotency key.\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.idempotency_body_ok(b jsonb, c_scope text, c_status integer)\nRETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $f$\nDECLARE\n  keys text[] := ARRAY['settlementId','eventId','version','accepted','idempotentReplay'];\n  v    integer;\nBEGIN\n  IF b IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(b) <> 'object' THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(b)) <> 5\n     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(b) k WHERE k <> ALL (keys)) THEN\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.is_uuid_text(clearledger.jtext(b, 'settlementId'))\n     OR NOT clearledger.is_uuid_text(clearledger.jtext(b, 'eventId')) THEN\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  IF jsonb_typeof(b -> 'version') <> 'number' OR (b ->> 'version') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,8}$' THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF b -> 'accepted' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb OR b -> 'idempotentReplay' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb THEN\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  v := (b ->> 'version')::integer;\n  IF c_scope ~ '^create:' THEN\n    IF c_status <> 201 OR v <> 1 THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  ELSIF c_scope ~ '^entry:' THEN\n    IF c_status <> 202 OR v < 2 THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  ELSE\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN lower(substr(c_scope, position(':' in c_scope) + 1)) = lower(b ->> 'settlementId');\nEXCEPTION WHEN others THEN\n  RETURN false;\nEND $f$;\n\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n-- Trigger functions.\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.reject_mutation()\nRETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$\nBEGIN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION '% on %.% is forbidden: table is append-only', TG_OP, TG_TABLE_SCHEMA, TG_TABLE_NAME\n    USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\nEND $f$;\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.settlements_before_update()\nRETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$\nBEGIN\n  -- An omitted memo keeps the previous one so last_memo is never NULL.\n  NEW.last_memo := COALESCE(NEW.last_memo, OLD.last_memo);\n\n  IF OLD.current_status = 'RECONCILED' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement % is RECONCILED and can no longer be updated', OLD.settlement_id\n      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.settlement_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.settlement_id\n     OR NEW.account_id   IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.account_id\n     OR NEW.reference    IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reference\n     OR NEW.debit_party  IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.debit_party\n     OR NEW.credit_party IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_party\n     OR NEW.created_at   IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement % header columns are immutable', OLD.settlement_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.version + 1 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement % version must advance from % by exactly 1', OLD.settlement_id, OLD.version\n      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.entry_count IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.entry_count + 1 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement % entry_count must advance by exactly 1', OLD.settlement_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.last_entry_id IS NULL OR NEW.last_entry_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_entry_id THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement % update requires a new last_entry_id', OLD.settlement_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF (NEW.updated_at > OLD.updated_at) IS NOT TRUE THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement % updated_at must strictly increase', OLD.settlement_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.status_transition_ok(OLD.current_status, NEW.current_status) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement % status transition % -> % is not allowed',\n      OLD.settlement_id, OLD.current_status, NEW.current_status USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND $f$;\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.events_before_insert()\nRETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$\nDECLARE\n  s          clearledger.settlements%ROWTYPE;\n  d          jsonb := NEW.payload -> 'data';\n  last_ver   integer;\n  prev_at    timestamptz;\n  prev_state text;\n  want_memo  text;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO s FROM clearledger.settlements WHERE settlement_id = NEW.settlement_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'event % references unknown settlement %', NEW.event_id, NEW.settlement_id\n      USING ERRCODE = 'foreign_key_violation';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT max(aggregate_version) INTO last_ver FROM clearledger.events WHERE settlement_id = NEW.settlement_id;\n  IF NEW.aggregate_version IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(last_ver, 0) + 1 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement % aggregate_version must be contiguous: expected %, got %',\n      NEW.settlement_id, COALESCE(last_ver, 0) + 1, NEW.aggregate_version USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NEW.event_type = 'LedgerEntryRecorded' AND EXISTS (\n       SELECT 1 FROM clearledger.events e\n        WHERE e.settlement_id = NEW.settlement_id\n          AND e.event_type = 'LedgerEntryRecorded'\n          AND e.payload -> 'data' ->> 'entryId' = d ->> 'entryId') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'entryId % already recorded for settlement %', d ->> 'entryId', NEW.settlement_id\n      USING ERRCODE = 'unique_violation';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- The event must describe the settlement row it was committed with.\n  IF s.account_id   IS DISTINCT FROM d ->> 'accountId'\n     OR s.reference    IS DISTINCT FROM d ->> 'reference'\n     OR s.debit_party  IS DISTINCT FROM d ->> 'debitParty'\n     OR s.credit_party IS DISTINCT FROM d ->> 'creditParty'\n     OR s.current_status IS DISTINCT FROM d ->> 'status'\n     OR s.current_stage  IS DISTINCT FROM d ->> 'clearingStage'\n     OR s.last_entry_id  IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(d ->> 'entryId', '')::uuid\n     OR s.version        IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.aggregate_version\n     OR s.updated_at     IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.occurred_at\n     OR (NEW.aggregate_version = 1 AND s.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.occurred_at) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'event % does not match settlement % row at version %',\n      NEW.event_id, NEW.settlement_id, s.version USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n\n  want_memo := d ->> 'memo';\n  IF want_memo IS NULL THEN\n    SELECT e.payload -> 'data' ->> 'memo' INTO want_memo\n      FROM clearledger.events e\n     WHERE e.settlement_id = NEW.settlement_id\n       AND e.aggregate_version < NEW.aggregate_version\n       AND e.payload -> 'data' ->> 'memo' IS NOT NULL\n     ORDER BY e.aggregate_version DESC\n     LIMIT 1;\n  END IF;\n  IF s.last_memo IS DISTINCT FROM want_memo THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'event % memo does not match settlement % last_memo', NEW.event_id, NEW.settlement_id\n      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NEW.aggregate_version >= 2 THEN\n    SELECT e.occurred_at, e.payload -> 'data' ->> 'status' INTO prev_at, prev_state\n      FROM clearledger.events e\n     WHERE e.settlement_id = NEW.settlement_id AND e.aggregate_version = NEW.aggregate_version - 1;\n    IF prev_at IS NULL OR (NEW.occurred_at > prev_at) IS NOT TRUE THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'event % occurred_at must be strictly after the previous event', NEW.event_id\n        USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n    END IF;\n    IF NOT clearledger.status_transition_ok(prev_state, d ->> 'status') THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'event % status transition % -> % is not allowed', NEW.event_id, prev_state, d ->> 'status'\n        USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND $f$;\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.outbox_before_insert()\nRETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$\nDECLARE\n  ev       clearledger.events%ROWTYPE;\n  last_ver integer;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO ev FROM clearledger.events WHERE event_id = NEW.event_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox row references unknown event %', NEW.event_id USING ERRCODE = 'foreign_key_violation';\n  END IF;\n  IF ev.settlement_id <> NEW.settlement_id\n     OR ev.aggregate_version <> NEW.aggregate_version\n     OR ev.correlation_id <> NEW.correlation_id\n     OR ev.payload IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.payload THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox row for event % must mirror the events row', NEW.event_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT max(aggregate_version) INTO last_ver FROM clearledger.outbox WHERE settlement_id = NEW.settlement_id;\n  IF NEW.aggregate_version IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(last_ver, 0) + 1 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox aggregate_version for settlement % must be contiguous: expected %, got %',\n      NEW.settlement_id, COALESCE(last_ver, 0) + 1, NEW.aggregate_version USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND $f$;\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.outbox_before_update()\nRETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.seq IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.seq\n     OR NEW.event_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.event_id\n     OR NEW.settlement_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.settlement_id\n     OR NEW.aggregate_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.aggregate_version\n     OR NEW.correlation_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.correlation_id\n     OR NEW.payload IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.payload\n     OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox envelope columns of event % are immutable', OLD.event_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.attempts < OLD.attempts THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox attempts of event % cannot decrease', OLD.event_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF OLD.published_at IS NULL THEN\n    IF NEW.published_at IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.attempts <= OLD.attempts OR NEW.archived_at IS NOT NULL) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'publishing outbox event % requires attempts to increase and archived_at to stay NULL',\n        OLD.event_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n    END IF;\n  ELSE\n    IF NEW.published_at IS NOT NULL THEN\n      IF NEW.published_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.published_at\n         OR NEW.attempts IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.attempts\n         OR NEW.last_error IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_error THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION 'published outbox event % delivery columns are immutable', OLD.event_id\n          USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n      END IF;\n      IF OLD.archived_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.archived_at IS NOT NULL\n         AND NEW.archived_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.archived_at THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION 'archived_at of outbox event % cannot change without being reset first', OLD.event_id\n          USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n      END IF;\n    ELSE\n      -- operational replay: published_at and archived_at are reset together\n      IF NEW.archived_at IS NOT NULL\n         OR NEW.attempts IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.attempts\n         OR NEW.last_error IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_error THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION 'replay reset of outbox event % must clear both published_at and archived_at', OLD.event_id\n          USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND $f$;\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.idempotency_before_insert()\nRETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$\nDECLARE\n  b          jsonb := NEW.response_body;\n  ev_id      uuid;\n  s_id       uuid;\n  ver        integer;\nBEGIN\n  BEGIN\n    ev_id := (b ->> 'eventId')::uuid;\n WHERE (k.response_body ->> 'eventId')::uuid = ev_id\n                 OR ((k.response_body ->> 'settlementId')::uuid = s_id\n                     AND (k.response_body ->> 'version')::integer = ver)) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'event % is already bound to an idempotency key', ev_id USING ERRCODE = 'unique_violation';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND $f$;\n\n-- Deploy this as a container-based **AWS Lambda** function triggered every minute (`rate(1 minute)`) by **EventBridge Scheduler**. 4. **Audit archiver (`archiver_image`)**: Reads published settlement events from PostgreSQL (`published_at IS NOT NULL AND archived_at IS NULL`) and writes deterministic NDJSON audit batches (`ledger-audit/batch-*.ndjson`) to a private, versioned **Amazon S3** bucket. Deploy this as a container-based **AWS Lambda** function triggered every five minutes (`rate(5 minutes)`) by **EventBridge Scheduler**.  ## Workspace Environment and Contracts  The workspace comes with `terraform`, `tofu`, `aws`, `psql`, `jq`, `curl`, and Python 3 pre-installed. The local AWS control plane (`http://aws:4566`, region `us-east-1`) is configured through `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL` and `/workspace/config/config.json`. Docker is intentionally disabled inside the workspace; provision every cloud resource through Terraform or OpenTofu against the AWS endpoint.  Read the contract files under `/workspace/contracts/` before writing your code:  - `/workspace/contracts/runtime.md`: Container environment variables for the API and each Lambda worker (`DATABASE_URL`, `SQS_QUEUE_URL`, `PROJECTION_TABLE`, `VALKEY_URL`, `CACHE_TTL_SECONDS`, `OUTBOX_BATCH_SIZE`, `AUDIT_BUCKET`, `AUDIT_PREFIX`, `AUTH_ISSUER`, `AUTH_AUDIENCES`, `AUTH_JWKS_URL`, `CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP`), the three non-hierarchical Cognito OAuth2 scopes (`clearledger/read`, `clearledger/write`, `clearledger/admin`), and the data-plane reconciliation rules required when `deploy.sh` runs. - `/workspace/contracts/infrastructure.md` and `/workspace/contracts/services/*.md`: Service-by-service infrastructure requirements covering:   - `services/vpc.md`: Two-AZ VPC (`us-east-1a` and `us-east-1b`), public and private subnets, route tables, and four least-privilege security groups (`alb`, `ecs`, `rds`, `valkey`).   - `services/alb.md` and `services/ecs.md`: Application Load Balancer, target group (`deregistration_delay = 5`, `/health/ready` health check with `interval = 5`, `timeout = 2`, `healthy_threshold = 2`), HTTP listener, ECS cluster (`containerInsights = \"enabled\"`), Fargate task definition (`lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }`), and service configuration.   - `services/rds.md`: RDS PostgreSQL 16 (`db.t4g.micro`) instance settings and the `clearledger` schema (`settlements`, `events`, `outbox`, `idempotency_keys`), `CHECK` / `UNIQUE` / `FOREIGN KEY` constraints, PL/pgSQL triggers (including `last_memo` retention on settlement updates when `memo` is omitted), and all six required partial, composite, and expression indexes.   - `services/sqs.md`, `services/lambda.md`, and `services/scheduler.md`: Main SQS queue and DLQ parameters and queue resource policies, Lambda container workers (with explicit `image_config` blocks), SQS event source mapping, and EventBridge Scheduler rules.   - `services/dynamodb.md`, `services/elasticache-valkey.md`, and `services/s3.md`: DynamoDB key schema (`PK`/`SK`), `AccountIndex` GSI (`GSI1PK`/`GSI1SK`), and point-in-time recovery, ElastiCache Valkey 8 (`cache.t4g.micro` with explicit `transit_encryption_enabled = false` and `at_rest_encryption_enabled = false`), and S3 bucket versioning, KMS encryption, public-access block, bucket resource policy, and canonical batch key layout.   - `services/cognito.md`, `services/iam.md`, `services/kms.md`, and `services/cloudwatch-logs.md`: Cognito User Pool, resource server, and three client-credentials app clients, the six dedicated IAM roles (`ecs_execution`, `ecs_task`, `projector`, `relay`, `archiver`, `scheduler`) with both least-privilege `Allow` statements and explicit `Effect = \"Deny\"` guardrails, the four customer-managed KMS keys, key policies, and aliases (`database`, `messaging`, `projection`, `audit`), and the four CloudWatch Log Groups (`retention_in_days >= 14`). - `/workspace/contracts/openapi.yaml`: HTTP endpoints, request and response bodies, required request headers (`Idempotency-Key`, `X-Correlation-Id`), and response headers (`X-ClearLedger-Source`, `X-ClearLedger-Version`, `X-ClearLedger-Instance`). - `/workspace/contracts/schemas/events.schema.json`: Domain event envelope schema used on SQS and in S3 NDJSON audit batches. - `/workspace/contracts/schemas/manifest.schema.json`: JSON Schema for `/workspace/submission/manifest.json` (`additionalProperties: false` throughout).  Deployment inputs (`resource_prefix`, `region`, `aws_endpoint_url`, `db_name`, `db_username`, `db_password`, and the four container image tags and digests: `api_image` / `clearledger/api:1.0.0`, `projector_image` / `clearledger/projector:1.0.0`, `relay_image` / `clearledger/relay:1.0.0`, `archiver_image` / `clearledger/archiver:1.0.0`) are stored in `/workspace/config/config.json`. Read those values dynamically in `deploy.sh` and `destroy.sh` instead of hardcoding values from the current workspace.  ## Deliverables and Lifecycle Rules  Write your solution under `/workspace/submission/`:  ```text /workspace/submission/ ????????? deploy.sh ????????? destroy.sh ????????? manifest.json ????????? infra/     ????????? *.tf (or *.tofu) ```  - `infra/`: Your Terraform or OpenTofu configuration. Your job is to write the Terraform or OpenTofu configuration, wire up the networking, KMS keys, Cognito OAuth2 scopes, and IAM roles, initialize the PostgreSQL schema and triggers, and provide deployment and teardown scripts that hold up under live traffic and recovery drills.  The application is already compiled into four container images and loaded into the local runtime. Do not rebuild or modify the application binaries. Your work is strictly on the infrastructure, database schema, and operational lifecycle side:  1. **API service (`api_image`)**: Serves the HTTP API (`POST /v1/settlements`, `POST /v1/settlements/{id}/entries`, `GET /v1/settlements/{id}`, `GET /v1/settlements/{id}/ledger`, `POST /v1/admin/projections/{id}/rebuild`, `/health/live`, and `/health/ready`). Run this on **ECS Fargate** (`desired_count = 2` across `us-east-1a` and `us-east-1b`) in private subnets behind an internet-facing **Application Load Balancer** (`port 80` HTTP listener forwarding to a target group on `port 8080` with `/health/ready` health checks). 2. **Projector (`projector_image`)**: Consumes domain events from the main **SQS** queue, writes the current settlement projection and ordered ledger event items into **DynamoDB**, and invalidates stale cached projections in **ElastiCache for Valkey**. Deploy this as a container-based **AWS Lambda** function connected to the main SQS queue via an event source mapping (`batch_size = 5`, `ReportBatchItemFailures` enabled) backed by a dead-letter queue (`maxReceiveCount = 4`). 3. **Outbox relay (`relay_image`)**: Polls **Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL** for committed outbox rows (`published_at IS NULL`), publishes them to the main SQS queue, and stamps `published_at`. Deploy this as a container-based **AWS Lambda** function triggered every minute (`rate(1 minute)`) by **EventBridge Scheduler**. 4. **Audit archiver (`archiver_image`)**: Reads published settlement events from PostgreSQL (`published_at IS NOT NULL AND archived_at IS NULL`) and writes deterministic NDJSON audit batches (`ledger-audit/batch-*.ndjson`) to a private, versioned **Amazon S3** bucket. Deploy this as a container-based **AWS Lambda** function triggered every five minutes (`rate(5 minutes)`) by **EventBridge Scheduler**.  ## Workspace Environment and Contracts  The workspace comes with `terraform`, `tofu`, `aws`, `psql`, `jq`, `curl`, and Python 3 pre-installed. The local AWS control plane (`http://aws:4566`, region `us-east-1`) is configured through `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL` and `/workspace/config/config.json`. Docker is intentionally disabled inside the workspace; provision every cloud resource through Terraform or OpenTofu against the AWS endpoint.  Read the contract files under `/workspace/contracts/` before writing your code:  - `/workspace/contracts/runtime.md`: Container environment variables for the API and each Lambda worker (`DATABASE_URL`, `SQS_QUEUE_URL`, `PROJECTION_TABLE`, `VALKEY_URL`, `CACHE_TTL_SECONDS`, `OUTBOX_BATCH_SIZE`, `AUDIT_BUCKET`, `AUDIT_PREFIX`, `AUTH_ISSUER`, `AUTH_AUDIENCES`, `AUTH_JWKS_URL`, `CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP`), the three non-hierarchical Cognito OAuth2 scopes (`clearledger/read`, `clearledger/write`, `clearledger/admin`), and the data-plane reconciliation rules required when `deploy.sh` runs. - `/workspace/contracts/infrastructure.md` and `/workspace/contracts/services/*.md`: Service-by-service infrastructure requirements covering:   - `services/vpc.md`: Two-AZ VPC (`us-east-1a` and `us-east-1b`), public and private subnets, route tables, and four least-privilege security groups (`alb`, `ecs`, `rds`, `valkey`).   - `services/alb.md` and `services/ecs.md`: Application Load Balancer, target group (`deregistration_delay = 5`, `/health/ready` health check with `interval = 5`, `timeout = 2`, `healthy_threshold = 2`), HTTP listener, ECS cluster (`containerInsights = \"enabled\"`), Fargate task definition (`lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }`), and service configuration.   - `services/rds.md`: RDS PostgreSQL 16 (`db.t4g.micro`) instance settings and the `clearledger` schema (`settlements`, `events`, `outbox`, `idempotency_keys`), `CHECK` / `UNIQUE` / `FOREIGN KEY` constraints, PL/pgSQL triggers (including `last_memo` retention on settlement updates when `memo` is omitted), and all six required partial, composite, and expression indexes.   - `services/sqs.md`, `services/lambda.md`, and `services/scheduler.md`: Main SQS queue and DLQ parameters and queue resource policies, Lambda container workers (with explicit `image_config` blocks), SQS event source mapping, and EventBridge Scheduler rules.   - `services/dynamodb.md`, `services/elasticache-valkey.md`, and `services/s3.md`: DynamoDB key schema (`PK`/`SK`), `AccountIndex` GSI (`GSI1PK`/`GSI1SK`), and point-in-time recovery, ElastiCache Valkey 8 (`cache.t4g.micro` with explicit `transit_encryption_enabled = false` and `at_rest_encryption_enabled = false`), and S3 bucket versioning, KMS encryption, public-access block, bucket resource policy, and canonical batch key layout.   - `services/cognito.md`, `services/iam.md`, `services/kms.md`, and `services/cloudwatch-logs.md`: Cognito User Pool, resource server, and three client-credentials app clients, the six dedicated IAM roles (`ecs_execution`, `ecs_task`, `projector`, `relay`, `archiver`, `scheduler`) with both least-privilege `Allow` statements and explicit `Effect = \"Deny\"` guardrails, the four customer-managed KMS keys, key policies, and aliases (`database`, `messaging`, `projection`, `audit`), and the four CloudWatch Log Groups (`retention_in_days >= 14`). - `/workspace/contracts/openapi.yaml`: HTTP endpoints, request and response bodies, required request headers (`Idempotency-Key`, `X-Correlation-Id`), and response headers (`X-ClearLedger-Source`, `X-ClearLedger-Version`, `X-ClearLedger-Instance`). - `/workspace/contracts/schemas/events.schema.json`: Domain event envelope schema used on SQS and in S3 NDJSON audit batches. - `/workspace/contracts/schemas/manifest.schema.json`: JSON Schema for `/workspace/submission/manifest.json` (`additionalProperties: false` throughout).  Deployment inputs (`resource_prefix`, `region`, `aws_endpoint_url`, `db_name`, `db_username`, `db_password`, and the four container image tags and digests: `api_image` / `clearledger/api:1.0.0`, `projector_image` / `clearledger/projector:1.0.0`, `relay_image` / `clearledger/relay:1.0.0`, `archiver_image` / `clearledger/archiver:1.0.0`) are stored in `/workspace/config/config.json`. Read those values dynamically in `deploy.sh` and `destroy.sh` instead of hardcoding values from the current workspace.  ## Deliverables and Lifecycle Rules  Write your solution under `/workspace/submission/`:  ```text /workspace/submission/ ????????? deploy.sh ????????? destroy.sh ????????? manifest.json ????????? infra/     ????????? *.tf (or *.tofu) ```  - `infra/`: Your Terraform or OpenTofu configuration.
